reply_text:
I answered Tobias in his thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from the incident channel itself, which Tobias is a member of. On 2025-09-03 Priyanka Sundaram posted that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. When she closed the incident she said Southgate had cleared the backlog.

Nobody in the channel gave a full address for the site, and I couldn't see any Tansley account files in the share. I told him to ask Priyanka if he needs the exact address.
